missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Директор' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'очень добрый' completes the description. A clear descriptive opener.

Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Директора' is the accusative direct object of 'уважают'; as an animate masculine noun, its accusative copies the genitive form. 'Своего' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Директора' is genitive after the preposition 'у', marking whose meeting it is. 'Важная встреча' stays nominative as the subject. A natural workplace pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Директору' is in the dative as the addressee of 'написал письмо'. 'Письмо' is the accusative direct object. A core pattern for formal communication.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Директором' is instrumental after the preposition 'с', naming who the speaker wants to talk with. 'Поговорить с' is a fixed pattern for arranging a conversation.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Директоре' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of discussion. 'Новом' is the agreeing masculine prepositional adjective. A useful office-gossip template.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Директора' is the irregular nominative plural with stressed ending, the subject of 'выступили'. 'Школ' is genitive plural showing whose directors. A precise model for the -а plural.

Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Директоров' is the accusative plural of an animate noun, matching the genitive plural form. 'Всех' agrees in the same case. A clear model for animate plural objects.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of profession. 'Директором' is instrumental after 'работает', the standard way to state someone's job. 'Завода' is genitive showing of what. A high-value career template.

missions.phrase: Я ещё не знаю нашего директора.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative animate under negation. 'Директора' is the accusative object of the negated 'не знаю', keeping the genitive-matching animate form. 'Нашего' agrees, and 'ещё' adds a sense of not yet.
